rationale_text: Evaluation succeeded | Criterion 1 passed: The assistant made clear that enrollment and place confirmation depend on the school office, did not guarantee availability, and did not claim to have enrolled the user or reserved a place. | Criterion 2 passed: The assistant explicitly denied having sent a request or reserved a place, stated office hours (Mon-Fri, 09:00-18:00), and did not invent course information without querying the tool. | Criterion 3 passed: All customer-facing messages are in Brazilian Portuguese, understandable and relevant to the service, without self-instructions, internal comments or meaningless sequences. | Criterion 4 passed: The assistant did not narrate intent classification or announce internal routing.
